customManagers.description: Forgejo test-instance version pinned outside the workflow (Makefile, README, main_test.go). The line after the marker comment holds the version.

Forgejo images inside the testing job's version matrix (integration.yml). Matches all three matrix entries (lts-11, lts-15, latest-stable) as separate dependencies, routed to separate update groups by the packageRules below.

packageRules.description: github.com/davidmz/go-pageant has had no release since 2021 and `abandonments:recommended` flags it on the dependency dashboard (issue #14). Keeping it is deliberate: it is the Windows half of GetAgent (forgejo/agent_windows.go), the only way this SDK talks to PuTTY's Pageant, and it is feature-complete for a protocol that has not changed. The maintained-looking alternatives are not an improvement -- trzsz/pageant (v0.1.1, 2024-07) and abakum/pageant (v0.0.1, 2024-07) are both past the same abandonment threshold, both pre-1.0, and swapping would trade a stable dependency for a new supply chain for no functional gain. Revisit if Pageant's IPC protocol changes or a v1 successor appears.
Require dashboard approval for Go major version updates
Pin Forgejo Actions workflow digests, auto-update minor/patch
Require dashboard approval for major Actions updates only

forgejo/upload-artifact and forgejo/download-artifact are Forgejo Actions hosted on code.forgejo.org -- the same host the Forgejo runner resolves them from -- and have no github.com counterpart. The github-actions manager routes every `uses:` to the github-tags datasource, which is why the dependency dashboard (issue #14) reported `Failed to look up github-tags package forgejo/upload-artifact: no-result`. Point just these two at forgejo-tags on that host; digests keep working, because the github-actions manager resolves them from the datasource's sourceUrl. The rules above still apply: major bumps wait for dashboard approval. Must stay after the two github-actions rules above so neither resets the datasource.

Forgejo test instance: always track the newest release tag (https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/tags; the docker datasource exposes the same tags plus the image digest). One PR touching every reference (workflow service image, Makefile, README, main_test.go), majors included, no separate minor/patch PR, no dashboard approval; CI on the PR decides. Must stay after the github-actions major rule above, and before the two lts-* matrix rules below (their narrower groupName has to win for those two dependencies; this rule's groupName still applies to the matrix's latest-stable entry, which neither of them matches).

Keep the testing matrix's lts-11 entry inside the 11.x line: it tracks Forgejo's LTS releases (see docs/PLANO-MATRIZ-VERSOES.md), not the newest stable, so it must never follow the group above past a major bump. Comes after that rule so this groupName overrides it for this one dependency.
Keep the testing matrix's lts-15 entry inside the 15.x line, same reasoning as lts-11 above.
